stories.title: The Creation & the Garden
stories.blurb: Six days of light, seas, and living things; a garden eastward in Eden; and the fruit that opened mortal eyes — where every human story begins.

stories.title: Noah & the Ark
stories.blurb: A preacher of righteousness builds for a flood no one believes in — gopher wood, pitch, every living kind by twos, and at last a dove with an olive leaf.

stories.title: Abraham's Test on Moriah
stories.blurb: 'Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest' — three days of walking, an altar, a raised knife, and the ram God provided.

stories.title: Joseph Forgives His Brothers
stories.blurb: The governor of Egypt clears the room, weeps aloud, and tells the men who sold him: 'ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.'

stories.title: The Burning Bush
stories.blurb: A bush that burns and is not consumed, shoes off on holy ground, and a name from the fire — I AM THAT I AM — sending a reluctant shepherd back to Egypt.

stories.title: Crossing the Red Sea
stories.blurb: Trapped between chariots and water, Israel hears the impossible command: go forward. The sea stands in walls, and a slave nation walks out free.

stories.title: The Ten Commandments
stories.blurb: Thunder, smoke, and a trumpet waxing louder — from the top of Sinai, God himself speaks the ten words that anchor the covenant.

stories.title: Joshua & the Walls of Jericho
stories.blurb: Jordan heaped dry for the crossing, then seven silent circuits, seven trumpets, and one great shout — the first city of the promised land falls without a siege.

stories.title: Gideon's Three Hundred
stories.blurb: 'The people that are with thee are too many' — God trims an army to 300 lappers of water, then routs Midian with trumpets, torches, and broken pitchers.

stories.title: Ruth & Naomi
stories.blurb: Two widows walk from Moab to Bethlehem with nothing; gleaned barley, a kinsman-redeemer at the gate, and a grandmother's lap — the road to King David runs through loyalty.

stories.title: David & Goliath
stories.blurb: Forty days of the giant's taunts end when a shepherd boy declines Saul's armor and answers with a sling: 'thou comest to me with a sword... I come in the name of the Lord.'

stories.title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
stories.blurb: In a dream at Gibeon the new king asks not for riches or long life but an understanding heart — then proves it with a sword and two mothers claiming one child.

stories.title: Elijah & the Priests of Baal
stories.blurb: One altar drenched three times over against 450 prophets who cry all day to silence — then fire falls from heaven and licks up even the water in the trench.

stories.title: The Fiery Furnace
stories.blurb: 'Our God is able to deliver us — but if not...' Three Hebrews walk into flames heated seven times over, and the king counts four men loose, walking unhurt.

stories.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
stories.blurb: Knowing the decree is signed, Daniel opens his window toward Jerusalem and prays as before — and spends the night with lions whose mouths an angel shut.

stories.title: Jonah & the Great Fish
stories.blurb: A prophet sails hard away from his call, prays from the belly of the deep, and watches the city he wanted burned repent in sackcloth — from the king down to the cattle.

stories.title: Esther: For Such a Time as This
stories.blurb: A death decree over every Jew in Persia, a queen who has hidden her people, and Mordecai's question that tips the scale — then three days of fasting and an uninvited walk to the throne.
